clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Tallow watches the contested front lines for the Dark Lady and the Horde. The Forsaken warrior helps organize strikes against Alliance threats in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Tallow stands with the Forsaken and Horde forces holding Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Conflict stirs across the region, with Southshore humans nearby, Syndicate outlaws on the roads, and hostile wildlife beyond the town. Tallow sends capable adventurers against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands to test their strength. Then he directs them to aid the besieged outpost of Hammerfall.
